title: You’ll Regret Not Going on a Boat Ride in this Ancient Water Near Shanghai China 🇨🇳
description:
Most families visit Shanghai and head straight to the skyscrapers.

But just about an hour away is a place that slows everything down.

Stone bridges.
Narrow canals.
Hundreds of years of history.

The town is called Zhujiajiao Ancient Town.

And honestly?

It ended up being one of the most peaceful and beautiful stops on our China family trip.

If you’re planning family travel to Shanghai, this is why Zhujiajiao is worth visiting:

1️⃣ It shows a completely different side of China
Shanghai is futuristic. Zhujiajiao feels like stepping back 1,700 years into ancient canal town life.

2️⃣ Kids love the boat ride
For children, riding through the waterways feels like a real life adventure story.

3️⃣ The bridges are iconic
There are dozens of historic bridges here. The most famous one is the Fangsheng Bridge which is over 400 years old.

4️⃣ It’s slower and calmer than the big city
After the noise of Shanghai, this place feels relaxing for families.

Fun travel trivia:
Zhujiajiao is often called the “Venice of Shanghai” because of its network of canals and stone bridges built during the Ming and Qing dynasties.

If you’re traveling with kids, here are our top travel tips:

✨ Go early in the morning
It gets busy later in the day.

✨ Bring small cash
Street snacks and local treats are part of the experience.

✨ Let kids lead the exploring
There are tiny alleyways, snack stalls, and bridge viewpoints everywhere.

✨ Do the boat ride
It’s the highlight of the visit.

Best ways to get there from Shanghai:

🚗 DiDi or taxi
Most convenient if you’re traveling with kids. About 1 hour depending on traffic.

🚇 Metro Line 17
Budget friendly option. Stop at Zhujiajiao Station then a short ride to the old town.

🚌 Guided day tour
Easy option if you prefer everything arranged.

For us, it was one of those family travel moments that felt simple but unforgettable.
